hot_path_rule: Recorders are started on cold path. Hot path reads LastValue and writes blittable 32-byte records only.

counters.name: CPU Total Frame Time
counters.purpose: Frame-time gate; three consecutive samples above 25000 microseconds fail the run.
counters.fallback: Frame Time, then the last validated dispatcher FastTick delta converted to microseconds. UnityEngine.Time is not read from the hot metric path.

counters.name: GC Allocated In Frame
counters.purpose: Zero-GC proof gate; any non-zero value during simulation fails the run.
counters.fallback: No fallback value is trusted. Missing recorder emits 0 and metadata records recorder absence.

counters.name: Gfx Used Memory
counters.purpose: VRAM target gate; 1600 MB is the fatal project target for this bot.
counters.fallback: Gfx Used Memory Bytes, then Profiler.GetAllocatedMemoryForGraphicsDriver converted to MB.

counters.name: Batches Count
counters.purpose: Render pressure correlation in CSV and black-box dump.

counters.name: SetPass Calls Count
counters.purpose: Render state-change correlation in CSV and black-box dump.

storage.primary_owner: GlobalDataVault buffer ids 74240 and 74241, owner SystemID.QAEndurance.
storage.fallback: Preallocated managed arrays only if GlobalDataVault is unavailable before bootstrap.
